title: Gut microbial characteristics associated with pegylated interferon treatment response in chronic hepatitis B: insights into the gut–liver axis
abstract: Background Pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) treatment response varies considerably among patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). The role of the gut microbiota in this heterogeneity remains unclear. This study aimed to characterize gut microbial features associated with Peg-IFN response and explore their potential relevance to the gut–liver axis. Methods A total of 64 patients with CHB who completed 24 weeks of Peg-IFN-based therapy were enrolled in this study. Fecal samples collected at week 24 were analyzed using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Microbial characteristics and clinical factors associated with treatment response were evaluated, followed by development of an integrated classification model. Results Among the 64 patients, 38 were classified as responders and 26 as non-responders. Responders exhibited distinct gut microbial profiles, characterized by increased microbial richness ( p = 0.014), altered community composition ( p = 0.045), and different microbial interaction patterns. Dorea abundance was enriched in responders and independently associated with treatment response. Multivariable logistic regression identified lower baseline HBsAg levels (OR = 0.562, p = 0.048), higher platelet counts (OR = 1.020, p = 0.007), and increased Dorea abundance (OR = 3.876, p = 0.008) as independent factors associated with response. Restricted cubic spline analysis supported a significant association between Dorea abundance and response probability. The Virological–Host–Microbial (VHM) triad model integrating these factors demonstrated promising apparent discrimination (ROC-AUC = 0.790) and calibration in the development cohort. Conclusion Distinct gut microbial ecological patterns are associated with Peg-IFN treatment response in CHB, with Dorea representing a characteristic microbial feature. This study provides a multidimensional framework for understanding heterogeneity in interferon responsiveness and highlights the potential relevance of the gut–liver–immune axis.

abstract_zh: 背景 聚乙二醇化干扰素 (Peg-IFN) 治疗 的反应在 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者中差异很大。肠道微生物群在这种异质性中的作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在表征与 Peg-IFN 反应相关的肠道微生物特征,并探讨它们与肠-肝轴的潜在相关性。方法 共有 64 例完成 24 周 Peg-IFN 治疗的慢性乙型肝炎患者纳入本研究。使用 16S rRNA 基因测序对第 24 周收集的粪便样本进行分析。评估了与 治疗 反应相关的微生物特征和临床因素,然后开发了综合分类模型。结果 64 例患者中,38 例为有反应者,26 例为无反应者。应答者表现出独特的肠道微生物特征,其特征是微生物丰富度增加(p = 0.014)、群落组成改变(p = 0.045)和不同的微生物相互作用模式。Dorea 丰度在应答者中丰富,并且与 治疗 应答独立相关。多变量逻辑回归确定较低的基线 HBsAg 水平(OR = 0.562,p = 0.048)、较高的血小板计数(OR = 1.020,p = 0.007)和增加的 Dorea 丰度(OR = 3.876,p = 0.008)作为与缓解相关的独立因素。受限三次样条分析支持 Dorea 丰度与响应概率之间的显着关联。整合这些因素的病毒学-宿主-微生物 (VHM) 三联体模型在 队列研究 的开发中证明了有希望的明显区分 (ROC-AUC = 0.790) 和校准。结论 不同的肠道微生物生态模式与 CHB 中的 Peg-IFN 治疗 反应相关,其中 Dorea 代表了一种典型的微生物特征。这项研究为理解干扰素反应的异质性提供了一个多维框架,并强调了肠-肝-免疫轴的潜在相关性。

title: Distinct plasma proteomic trajectories during PD-1 blockade and PEG-IFNα therapy are associated with HBsAg response in chronic hepatitis B
abstract: Background PD-1 blockade and pegylated interferon-α (PEG-IFNα) are promising immunomodulatory strategies for chronic hepatitis B (CHB), but their systemic immune effects and response-associated proteomic patterns remain poorly defined. Methods We performed longitudinal plasma proteomic profiling using the Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel in 25 nucleos(t)ide analogue-suppressed patients with CHB receiving PD-1 blockade (n=10) or PEG-IFNα (n=15). Plasma samples were collected at baseline, week 12, and week 24. Longitudinal protein changes were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models, and associations with week-24 HBsAg decline were evaluated using responder–non-responder comparisons and Spearman’s rank correlation. Responders were defined by an HBsAg decline of ≥1 log 10 IU/mL at week 24. Results Seventy-seven proteins passed quality-control criteria. PEG-IFNα induced substantially broader longitudinal proteomic remodeling than PD-1 blockade, with most changes occurring within the first 12 weeks. Treatment-by-time analyses identified distinct trajectories between therapies, including differential changes in IL-18R1, TNF, CX3CL1, CXCL9, and CXCL10. Response-associated analyses suggested treatment-specific patterns: IL-10 was the leading exploratory signal in the PD-1 cohort, whereas IL-12B, CDCP1, and FGF-21 were more prominent in the PEG-IFNα cohort. These response-related associations did not remain significant after false discovery rate correction and were therefore considered exploratory. Conclusions PD-1 blockade and PEG-IFNα induce distinct longitudinal circulating inflammatory proteomic programs in CHB. Favorable HBsAg decline was accompanied by treatment-specific rather than universal proteomic signatures, supporting the potential value of longitudinal proteomics for mechanistic and biomarker studies of HBV functional-cure strategies.

Methods We performed longitudinal plasma proteomic profiling using the Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel in 25 nucleos(t)ide analogue-suppressed patients with CHB receiving PD-1 blockade (n=10) or PEG-IFNα (n=15). Plasma samples were collected at baseline, week 12, and week 24. Longitudinal protein changes were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models, and associations with week-24 HBsAg decline were evaluated using responder–non-responder comparisons and Spearman’s rank correlation. Responders were defined by an HBsAg decline of ≥1 log 10 IU/mL at week 24. Results Seventy-seven proteins passed quality-control criteria. PEG-IFNα induced substantially broader longitudinal proteomic remodeling than PD-1 blockade, with most changes occurring within the first 12 weeks. Treatment-by-time analyses identified distinct trajectories between therapies, including differential changes in IL-18R1, TNF, CX3CL1, CXCL9, and CXCL10. Response-associated analyses suggested treatment-specific patterns: IL-10 was the leading exploratory signal in the PD-1 cohort, whereas IL-12B, CDCP1, and FGF-21 were more prominent in the PEG-IFNα cohort. These response-related associations did not remain significant after false discovery rate correction and were therefore considered exploratory. Conclusions PD-1 blockade and PEG-IFNα induce distinct longitudinal circulating inflammatory proteomic programs in CHB. Favorable HBsAg decline was accompanied by treatment-specific rather than universal proteomic signatures, supporting the potential value of longitudinal proteomics for mechanistic and biomarker studies of HBV functional-cure strategies.

abstract_zh: 背景 PD-1 阻断和聚乙二醇化干扰素-α (PEG-IFNα) 是 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 的有前途的免疫调节策略,但它们的全身免疫效应和反应相关的蛋白质组学模式仍不清楚。方法 我们使用 Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel 对 25 名接受 PD-1 阻断 (n=10) 或 PEG-IFNα (n=15) 的核苷(酸)类似物抑制的 CHB 患者进行了纵向血浆蛋白质组分析。在基线、第 12 周和第 24 周收集血浆样本。使用线性混合效应模型分析纵向蛋白质变化,并使用有反应者与无反应者比较和 Spearman 等级相关性评估与第 24 周 HBsAg 下降的关联。有反应者的定义是第 24 周时 HBsAg 下降≥1 log 10 IU/mL。结果 77 种蛋白质通过了质量控制标准。与 PD-1 阻断相比,PEG-IFNα 诱导了更广泛的纵向蛋白质组重塑,大多数变化发生在前 12 周内。治疗 按时间分析确定了治疗之间不同的轨迹,包括 IL-18R1、TNF、CX3CL1、CXCL9 和 CXCL10 的差异变化。响应相关分析表明 治疗 特异性模式:IL-10 是 PD-1 队列研究 中的主要探索信号,而 IL-12B、CDCP1 和 FGF-21 在 PEG-IFNα 队列研究 中更为突出。这些与反应相关的关联在错误发现率校正后并不仍然显着,因此被认为是探索性的。结论 PD-1 阻断和 PEG-IFNα 在 CHB 中诱导不同的纵向循环炎症蛋白质组程序。有利的 HBsAg 下降伴随着 治疗 特异性而非普遍的蛋白质组学特征,支持纵向蛋白质组学对于 HBV 功能治疗策略的机制和生物标志物研究的潜在价值。

title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver and antiviral response in chronic hepatitis B: A systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: BACKGROUND Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) frequently coexists with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its association with antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB remains unclear. AIM To systematically evaluate the impact of MAFLD on antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB. METHODS This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. PubMed, the Cochrane Library, EMBASE, and Web of Science were searched for studies published up to November 30, 2025. Meta-analyses were performed to assess associations between MAFLD and antiviral treatment responses or clinical outcomes. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach, and leave-one-out sensitivity analyses were performed to evaluate robustness. RESULTS Thirty-two studies were included, of which 20 evaluated antiviral treatment efficacy and 13 assessed clinical outcomes in patients with CHB and concomitant MAFLD (one study reported both treatment responses and clinical outcomes). MAFLD was associated with a higher rate of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at 48 weeks [odds ratio (OR) = 1.41, 95%CI: 1.28-1.55], although this association was attenuated at 96 weeks (OR = 1.44, 95%CI: 0.96-2.16). No significant association was observed between MAFLD and hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance at any time-point. MAFLD was consistently associated with lower rates of alanine aminotransferase normalization and hepatitis B virus DNA clearance throughout the treatment duration. MAFLD was associated with a significantly increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) despite antiviral therapy (OR = 1.50, 95%CI: 1.01-2.24). Subgroup analyses according to the antiviral regimen revealed distinct patterns, partly explaining the heterogeneity in the overall analyses. Subgroup analyses suggested that the antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach partly explained the heterogeneity, particularly for hepatitis B virus DNA clearance and HCC. CONCLUSION MAFLD was associated with lower virological and biochemical response rates, higher odds of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at week 48, particularly among patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy, and higher odds of HCC in patients with CHB, but not with hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance. These findings support metabolic risk assessment in CHB management and highlight the need for standardized MAFLD/metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease definitions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述旨在评估 MAFLD 对 抗病毒药物 治疗 反应和 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者长期临床结果的影响。核心问题是 MAFLD 是否影响 CHB 患者对 抗病毒药物 治疗的病毒学、生化和临床反应。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本次系统评价和荟萃分析遵循 PRISMA 指南。证据基础包括来自 PubMed、Cochrane 图书馆、EMBASE 和 Web of Science 的截至 2025 年 11 月 30 日发表的研究。基于 抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法进行亚组分析,并进行留一敏感性分析以评估研究结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MAFLD 与较低的病毒学和生化反应率、第 48 周时乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除的几率较高(特别是在接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的患者中)以及尽管接受 抗病毒药物 治疗但发生肝细胞癌(HCC)的几率增加有关。然而,在任何时间点均未观察到 MAFLD 与乙型肝炎 e 抗原血清清除之间存在显着关联。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 亚组分析表明,抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法部分解释了总体结果的异质性,特别是 乙型肝炎病毒 DNA 清除率和 HCC 方面。证据没有报告 MAFLD 与这些结果相关的具体机制,也没有报告 MAFLD 对其他临床结果(如肝纤维化进展)的影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持将代谢风险评估纳入慢性乙型肝炎的管理,并强调需要对 MAFLD 和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病进行标准化定义。

title: Prevalence of protective hepatitis B surface antibody levels and associated factors among women admitted for delivery at Kawempe National Referral Hospital, Uganda: A cross-sectional study
abstract: Mother-to-child transmission sustains the burden of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in sub-Saharan Africa, yet little is known about whether women giving birth in Uganda are protected. We estimated the prevalence of protective hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs) levels, described serological profiles and identified associated factors among women admitted for delivery at Kawempe National Referral Hospital, Kampala. In this cross-sectional study, 418 women were selected by systematic random sampling in 2024 and interviewed about socio-demographic characteristics, hepatitis B testing, vaccination and exposures. Anti-HBs was quantified by electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (protective: ≥10 mIU/mL); other HBV markers were screened with a rapid test. Prevalence ratios were estimated with modified Poisson regression. Overall, 264 women (63.2%) reported vaccination: 203 during the current pregnancy and 61 before it only. Protective levels were found in 322 women (77.0%; 95% confidence interval [CI] 72.8–80.8): 50.6% of never-vaccinated women, 82.0% of those vaccinated before the current pregnancy only and 95.6% of those vaccinated during it. After adjustment, vaccination before the current pregnancy only (adjusted prevalence ratio 1.54; 95% CI 1.24–1.89) and during it (1.86; 95% CI 1.57–2.20) were associated with protection; no socio-demographic or behavioural factor was. Eighty-two women (19.6%) had no serological evidence of immunity or infection; 65 had never been vaccinated. Of 300 women who reported a previous negative test, 50 (16.7%) had never been vaccinated, and 68 of 250 vaccinated women with known completion status (27.2%) had not completed three doses, mostly because they were not told to return or forgot. The rapid test detected hepatitis B surface antigen in 21 women (5.0%), but discordant marker patterns suggest some false positives. One in five women reached delivery susceptible to HBV, largely because a negative test was not followed by vaccination. Linking every negative antenatal test to vaccination could close much of this gap.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study conducted at Kawempe National Referral Hospital in Uganda aimed to assess the prevalence of protective hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs) levels and associated factors among women giving birth. The study found that 77.0% of the 418 participants had protective levels, with higher rates among those vaccinated during the current pregnancy compared to those vaccinated before. After adjustment, vaccination during and before the current pregnancy was associated with protection, but no socio-demographic or behavioural factors were. The findings highlight the importance of ensuring vaccination following negative antenatal tests to reduce susceptibility to HBV. title: Longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis with concurrent acute sensorimotor polyneuropathy secondary to hepatitis B virus reactivation: a case report
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation is a recognised complication of immunosuppressive therapy. Neurological complications from HBV reactivation are rare, particularly concurrent involvement of the central and peripheral nervous systems. We report a case of longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis (LETM) with concurrent acute sensorimotor polyneuropathy following HBV reactivation after rituximab containing chemotherapy for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. A 58 year old man with a history of marginal zone lymphoma transformed to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) received rituximab based chemotherapy, with entecavir prescribed as antiviral prophylaxis because of previous HBV exposure. One month following cessation of chemotherapy, entecavir was discontinued. Six months later, he developed virologically confirmed HBV reactivation followed by acute progressive lower limb weakness, sensory disturbance, urinary retention and neuropathic pain. Neurological examination demonstrated bilateral lower limb weakness, areflexia, and a thoracic sensory level with impaired vibration and proprioception. Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a non-enhancing longitudinally extensive T2-hyperintense spinal cord lesion extending from C4 to T10, while nerve conduction studies demonstrated a sensorimotor polyneuropathy with axonal abnormalities and features suggestive of demyelination. Cerebrospinal fluid demonstrated mild protein elevation with pleocytosis, while extensive infectious, autoimmune and paraneoplastic investigations were unrevealing. Treatment with intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), alongside continued antiviral therapy with entecavir, was followed by progressive neurological recovery, with complete radiological resolution of the spinal cord lesion and gradual functional improvement, although mild distal sensory deficits persisted. HBV reactivation may rarely present with concurrent LETM and acute sensorimotor polyneuropathy. In patients presenting with acute myeloneuropathy following rituximab containing chemotherapy, particularly after premature discontinuation of antiviral prophylaxis, HBV reactivation should be considered in the differential diagnosis. Early recognition and combined antiviral and immunomodulatory therapy may be associated with favourable neurological outcomes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 再激活是免疫抑制治疗公认的并发症,而 HBV 再激活引起的神经系统并发症很少见,特别是同时累及中枢和周围神经系统。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们报告了一例弥漫性大 B 细胞淋巴瘤接受含利妥昔单抗化疗后 HBV 再激活后出现纵向广泛横贯性脊髓炎 (LETM) 并并发急性感觉运动多发性神经病的病例。
elements_zh.methods: 该患者接受了基于利妥昔单抗的化疗,由于既往乙型肝炎病毒暴露,恩替卡韦作为 抗病毒药物 预防药物。化疗停止一个月后,恩替卡韦停药,六个月后,他出现病毒学证实的乙型肝炎病毒再激活。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: HBV 再激活很少会同时出现 LETM 和急性感觉运动性多发性神经病。对于接受含利妥昔单抗化疗后出现急性脊髓神经病的患者,特别是提前停止 抗病毒药物 预防后,在鉴别 诊断 时应考虑 HBV 再激活。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 早期识别以及联合 抗病毒药物 和免疫调节治疗可能与良好的神经学结果相关。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告具体的设计限制或偏差。

abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 再激活是免疫抑制治疗公认的并发症。乙型肝炎病毒再激活引起的神经系统并发症很少见,特别是同时累及中枢和周围神经系统。我们报告了一例弥漫性大 B 细胞淋巴瘤接受含利妥昔单抗化疗后 HBV 再激活后出现纵向广泛横贯性脊髓炎 (LETM) 并并发急性感觉运动多发性神经病的病例。一名 58 岁男性,有边缘区淋巴瘤转化为弥漫性大 B 细胞淋巴瘤 (DLBCL) 的病史,接受了基于利妥昔单抗的化疗,并因既往 HBV 暴露而使用恩替卡韦作为 抗病毒药物 预防药物。停止化疗1个月后,恩替卡韦停药。六个月后,他出现病毒学证实的乙型肝炎病毒再激活,随后出现急性进行性下肢无力、感觉障碍、尿潴留和神经性疼痛。神经系统检查显示双侧下肢无力、反射消失、胸部感觉平面振动和本体感觉受损。磁共振成像显示从 C4 延伸至 T10 的非增强纵向广泛 T2 高信号脊髓病变,而神经传导研究显示感觉运动性多发性神经病,伴有轴突异常和提示脱髓鞘的特征。脑脊液显示轻度蛋白质升高并伴有细胞增多,而广泛的感染性、自身免疫性和副肿瘤性研究并未揭示这一点。治疗 静脉注射免疫球蛋白 (IVIG) 联合继续 抗病毒药物 恩替卡韦治疗后,神经功能逐渐恢复,脊髓病变完全放射学消退,功能逐渐改善,尽管轻度远端感觉缺陷仍然存在。HBV 再激活很少会同时出现 LETM 和急性感觉运动性多发性神经病。对于接受含利妥昔单抗化疗后出现急性脊髓神经病的患者,特别是提前停止 抗病毒药物 预防后,在鉴别 诊断 时应考虑 HBV 再激活。早期识别以及联合 抗病毒药物 和免疫调节治疗可能与良好的神经学结果相关。

title: Efficacy and safety of glucocorticoid therapy for hepatitis B virus-related liver failure
abstract: Objective To assess the clinical efficacy and safety of short-term glucocorticoid therapy in patients with early- or pre-stage hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related liver failure. Methods We retrospectively analyzed 143 patients with early- or pre-stage HBV-related liver failure treated at our center between January 2015 and December 2025. Of these, 43 received methylprednisolone conventional therapy (glucocorticoid group) and 100 received conventional therapy alone (conventional group). We analyzed the trends in total bilirubin (TBil), prothrombin time activity (PTA), and albumin (ALB) between the two groups during the initial 4 weeks, as well as 4-week clinical improvement, 12-week mortality, complications, and HBV-DNA changes. Results The glucocorticoid group showed faster TBil decline and earlier PTA improvement (both P < 0.05). Glucocorticoid group also had significantly higher 4-week clinical improvement (81.4% vs. 54.0%, P = 0.002) and lower 12-week mortality (2.3% vs. Glucocorticoid therapy was independently associated with 4-week improvement (OR = 4.21) and with a significantly lower risk of death (OR = 0.074). Overall complications were fewer in the glucocorticoid group (37.2% vs. No significant between-group differences were observed in HBV-DNA levels at baseline or week 4 ( P = 0.389 and P = 0.584, respectively). Conclusion For patients with early or pre-stage HBV-related liver failure, adding short-term methylprednisolone to traditional therapy accelerates the recovery of liver function, improves short-term outcomes, and reduces mortality without a statistically significant increase in complications;no significant increase in HBV-DNA was observed during the 4-week observation period.

title: Artificial intelligence-driven risk estimation, early detection, diagnostic characterisation and prognosis in hepatitis b-related hepatocellular carcinoma
abstract: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains the leading global antecedent of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet the surveillance framework on which early detection depends is constrained at both of its load-bearing points: The modest sensitivity of biannual ultrasonography for early-stage tumours, and the bounded discrimination of risk scores that compress a nonlinear, time-evolving process into a small set of additively weighted covariates. Artificial intelligence (AI) has been advanced as a corrective, but the term is applied loosely and the supporting evidence is drawn from heterogeneous populations and from clinical tasks that are frequently conflated. This narrative review appraises AI across four separable tasks in the HBV-HCC pathway: Risk estimation in chronic hepatitis B, early detection during surveillance, diagnostic characterisation of established lesions, and prognosis after diagnosis. We state what is and is not counted as AI, describe the search strategy and selection principles, and categorise every cited study according to whether its evidence is HBV-specific, mixed-aetiology, hepatitis C virus-derived, drawn from general HCC populations, or confined to recurrence and prognosis. Where machine-learning models built on routine clinical variables have been compared with established scores within a single validation cohort, they have discriminated more accurately. Convolutional networks have improved ultrasonographic lesion detection, serological and cell-free DNA methylation models have been applied to early-stage detection beyond alpha-fetoprotein, and multi-omics integration has been used for molecular subclassification. These findings rest on a literature that is predominantly retrospective and single-centre, in which external validation is the exception, calibration is reported inconsistently, explainability is uneven, and meta-analysts repeatedly judge the underlying studies to be at high risk of bias. Evidence drawn specifically from hepatitis B cohorts remains a minority of the published work, and no study has demonstrated that an AI-guided strategy improves stage at diagnosis or survival. Prospective multicentre validation, transparent calibration, adherence to TRIPOD+AI and PROBAST+AI, and deliberate inclusion of African and South Asian populations are therefore prerequisites rather than refinements.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in addressing challenges in the surveillance, detection, and management of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) associated with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. It highlights the limitations of current methods, such as the modest sensitivity of ultrasonography and the bounded discrimination of risk scores. The review categorises studies based on their focus on HBV-specific evidence, mixed aetiologies, or other related viruses like hepatitis C. It finds that AI models, when compared to traditional scores within single validation cohorts, show improved discrimination. However, the evidence is largely retrospective and single-centre, with limited external validation and inconsistent calibration. The review concludes that AI strategies require prospective multicentre validation, transparent calibration, and inclusion of underrepresented populations to be effective in improving outcomes for HBV-related HCC.

title: Time-Resolved Proteomic Analysis of Hepatitis B Virus Infection
abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major cause of chronic liver disease and hepatocellular carcinoma, yet its impact on host proteome dynamics during early infection remains poorly defined. Here, we performed time-resolved label-free quantitative (LFQ) proteomics to characterize the host response to HBV infection in human HepG2 hepatoma cells. Across five time points spanning the first 3 weeks of infection, we quantified 5365 unique proteins, including two HBV proteins (C/preC-derived and S), revealing subtle yet coordinated changes in the hepatocellular proteome. Early infection was characterized by selective alterations in cytoskeletal organization, extracellular matrix components, and focal adhesion pathways, alongside enrichment of complement-associated proteins. Notably, we identified a transient, specific increase in the abundance of complement component C5 without a corresponding change in C3, indicating differential regulation of complement pathway members during infection. These findings define a temporally resolved proteomic landscape of HBV–host interactions and uncover previously underappreciated complement dynamics consistent with a selective and restrained host response. Together, our results provide a framework for mechanistic studies of early viral infection and host adaptation.

The study quantified 5365 unique proteins across five time points, revealing coordinated changes in the hepatocellular proteome, including alterations in cytoskeletal organization, extracellular matrix components, and focal adhesion pathways. title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 感染的时间分辨蛋白质组学分析
source_body_en: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major cause of chronic liver disease and hepatocellular carcinoma, yet its impact on host proteome dynamics during early infection remains poorly defined. Here, we performed time-resolved label-free quantitative (LFQ) proteomics to characterize the host response to HBV infection in human HepG2 hepatoma cells. Across five time points spanning the first 3 weeks of infection, we quantified 5365 unique proteins, including two HBV proteins (C/preC-derived and S), revealing subtle yet coordinated changes in the hepatocellular proteome. Early infection was characterized by selective alterations in cytoskeletal organization, extracellular matrix components, and focal adhesion pathways, alongside enrichment of complement-associated proteins. Notably, we identified a transient, specific increase in the abundance of complement component C5 without a corresponding change in C3, indicating differential regulation of complement pathway members during infection. These findings define a temporally resolved proteomic landscape of HBV–host interactions and uncover previously underappreciated complement dynamics consistent with a selective and restrained host response. Together, our results provide a framework for mechanistic studies of early viral infection and host adaptation.

title: Seroprevalence of hepatitis B and hepatitis C and its trends in India: a systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: Hepatitis B (HBV) and Hepatitis C (HCV) are major public health challenges in India. Yet, the existing prevalence studies differ significantly regarding population characteristics, geographic location, and study design, complicating the interpretation of the overall disease burden. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to synthesize HBV and HCV seroprevalence in India from available evidence and identify variations across key subpopulations. A systematic search was conducted on PubMed, Embase, and Scopus for studies published from January 1999 to September 2024 reporting HBV and/or HCV seroprevalence in India. Following PRISMA guidelines, 87 studies (61 on HBV, 69 on HCV) were included. Given substantial heterogeneity across studies, pooled seroprevalence was estimated using a random-effects model. Subgroup analyses were conducted by publication year, study setting, population, and geographical region to explore variability. Eighty-seven studies reporting HBV or HCV seroprevalence in India were included. Considerable heterogeneity was observed across studies ( I 2 > 99%), reflecting differences in study populations, geographic regions, and study settings. The pooled seroprevalence was 3.0% [95% CI 2.0–4.0%] for HBV (HBsAg + ) ( n = 693,879 participants) and 4.0% [95% CI: 2.0–7.0%] for anti-HCV antibody ( n = 1,079,706 participants). However, substantial variation was observed across study populations. HBV prevalence ranged from approximately 1.0% among blood donors to higher levels in community-based settings (7.0%) and high-risk populations (4.0%). Geographically, HBV prevalence was highest in Northern (3.0%) and Western (3.0%) India. For HCV, prevalence was markedly higher among high-risk populations (11.0%). Regional analysis showed the highest HCV seroprevalence in Eastern India (10.0%) and Northern India (6.0%). Molecular confirmatory tests such as reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), HBV DNA, or HCV RNA detection were reported in 19 of the 87 included studies (21.8%); chemiluminescent microparticle immunoassay (CMIA) was classified as a serological immunoassay rather than a molecular method. These findings indicate considerable heterogeneity in the epidemiology of viral hepatitis across populations in India. This study highlights the persistent burden of HBV and HCV in India. Scaling up community-based screening, decentralizing molecular testing, and improving linkage-to-care are essential to strengthen India’s National Viral Hepatitis Control Programme (NVHCP) and to achieve the WHO 2030 Viral Hepatitis elimination targets. Systematic review registration: PROSPERO CRD42024576147

title_zh: 印度乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎的 血清流行率 及其趋势:系统评价和荟萃分析
source_body_en: Hepatitis B (HBV) and Hepatitis C (HCV) are major public health challenges in India. Yet, the existing prevalence studies differ significantly regarding population characteristics, geographic location, and study design, complicating the interpretation of the overall disease burden. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to synthesize HBV and HCV seroprevalence in India from available evidence and identify variations across key subpopulations. A systematic search was conducted on PubMed, Embase, and Scopus for studies published from January 1999 to September 2024 reporting HBV and/or HCV seroprevalence in India. Following PRISMA guidelines, 87 studies (61 on HBV, 69 on HCV) were included. Given substantial heterogeneity across studies, pooled seroprevalence was estimated using a random-effects model. Subgroup analyses were conducted by publication year, study setting, population, and geographical region to explore variability. Eighty-seven studies reporting HBV or HCV seroprevalence in India were included. Considerable heterogeneity was observed across studies ( I 2 > 99%), reflecting differences in study populations, geographic regions, and study settings. The pooled seroprevalence was 3.0% [95% CI 2.0–4.0%] for HBV (HBsAg + ) ( n = 693,879 participants) and 4.0% [95% CI: 2.0–7.0%] for anti-HCV antibody ( n = 1,079,706 participants). However, substantial variation was observed across study populations. HBV prevalence ranged from approximately 1.0% among blood donors to higher levels in community-based settings (7.0%) and high-risk populations (4.0%). Geographically, HBV prevalence was highest in Northern (3.0%) and Western (3.0%) India. For HCV, prevalence was markedly higher among high-risk populations (11.0%). Regional analysis showed the highest HCV seroprevalence in Eastern India (10.0%) and Northern India (6.0%). Molecular confirmatory tests such as reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), HBV DNA, or HCV RNA detection were reported in 19 of the 87 included studies (21.8%); chemiluminescent microparticle immunoassay (CMIA) was classified as a serological immunoassay rather than a molecular method. These findings indicate considerable heterogeneity in the epidemiology of viral hepatitis across populations in India. This study highlights the persistent burden of HBV and HCV in India. Scaling up community-based screening, decentralizing molecular testing, and improving linkage-to-care are essential to strengthen India’s National Viral Hepatitis Control Programme (NVHCP) and to achieve the WHO 2030 Viral Hepatitis elimination targets. Systematic review registration: PROSPERO CRD42024576147

title: A composite lymph node-targeting nanoadjuvant NA@DCM integrates TLR9 and mitochondrial metabolic reprogramming for enhanced hepatitis B vaccination
abstract: : Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global public health concern. Although hepatitis B subunit vaccines are safe and effective, improved adjuvants may further enhance their immunogenicity. We developed NA@DCM, an aluminum-based composite nanoadjuvant in which DSPE-PEG 2000 nanomicelles incorporating a covalently conjugated DSPE-PEG–CpG 1018 (DC) conjugate are interfacially assembled with nano-aluminum (NA). We evaluated draining lymph node (dLN) biodistribution, immunogenicity, and biosafety in murine models, and examined B-cell activation mechanisms by transcriptomic, Western blot, and pharmacological inhibition analyses. NA@DCM enhanced CpG-associated accumulation in dLNs at 6 h versus free CpG, with sustained retention and component colocalization over 48 h. Compared with its individual components and their physical mixture, NA@DCM increased antigen-specific IgG titers, the IgG2c/IgG1 ratio, IFN-γ + /TNF-α + / IL-2 + /IL-4 + CD4 + and CD8 + T cells, and germinal center responses, and matched an AS04-like reference formulation in total IgG. These features are consistent with a Th1-biased antibody profile. Mechanistically, NA@DCM enhanced Toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9)–NF-κB signaling and mitochondrial function, with increased superoxide-associated fluorescence, ATP production, and respiratory chain complex activities . Oligomycin A inhibition of ATP synthase attenuated bioenergetic responses and CD69/CD86 upregulation in human Namalwa and primary murine B cells, indicating mitochondrial ATP synthesis is required for NA@DCM-induced B-cell activation. NA@DCM showed favorable hemocompatibility in vitro and no overt acute toxicity in vivo ; repeated immunization induced early cytokine responses and local infiltration without detectable hepatic or renal abnormalities. Collectively, NA@DCM integrates lymph node-targeted delivery, TLR9-associated signaling, and mitochondrial bioenergetic modulation, supporting further preclinical development as a hepatitis B vaccine adjuvant.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces NA@DCM, a novel nanoadjuvant designed to enhance hepatitis B vaccination by integrating TLR9 signaling and mitochondrial metabolic reprogramming. The research aimed to evaluate its biodistribution, immunogenicity, and biosafety in murine models, with a focus on B-cell activation mechanisms. Results showed that NA@DCM significantly increased antigen-specific IgG titers, the IgG2c/IgG1 ratio, and T-cell responses compared to its individual components. Mechanistically, the nanoadjuvant enhanced TLR9–NF-κB signaling and mitochondrial function, with evidence that mitochondrial ATP synthesis is essential for B-cell activation. The study also demonstrated favorable hemocompatibility and safety profiles in vitro and in vivo. These findings suggest that NA@DCM could be a promising candidate for improving hepatitis B vaccine efficacy. However, the study is limited to murine models, and further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness in humans.

title_zh: 复合淋巴结靶向纳米佐剂 NA@DCM 整合 TLR9 和线粒体代谢重编程以增强乙型肝炎 疫苗接种
source_body_en: : Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global public health concern. Although hepatitis B subunit vaccines are safe and effective, improved adjuvants may further enhance their immunogenicity. We developed NA@DCM, an aluminum-based composite nanoadjuvant in which DSPE-PEG 2000 nanomicelles incorporating a covalently conjugated DSPE-PEG–CpG 1018 (DC) conjugate are interfacially assembled with nano-aluminum (NA). We evaluated draining lymph node (dLN) biodistribution, immunogenicity, and biosafety in murine models, and examined B-cell activation mechanisms by transcriptomic, Western blot, and pharmacological inhibition analyses. NA@DCM enhanced CpG-associated accumulation in dLNs at 6 h versus free CpG, with sustained retention and component colocalization over 48 h. Compared with its individual components and their physical mixture, NA@DCM increased antigen-specific IgG titers, the IgG2c/IgG1 ratio, IFN-γ + /TNF-α + / IL-2 + /IL-4 + CD4 + and CD8 + T cells, and germinal center responses, and matched an AS04-like reference formulation in total IgG. These features are consistent with a Th1-biased antibody profile. Mechanistically, NA@DCM enhanced Toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9)–NF-κB signaling and mitochondrial function, with increased superoxide-associated fluorescence, ATP production, and respiratory chain complex activities . Oligomycin A inhibition of ATP synthase attenuated bioenergetic responses and CD69/CD86 upregulation in human Namalwa and primary murine B cells, indicating mitochondrial ATP synthesis is required for NA@DCM-induced B-cell activation. NA@DCM showed favorable hemocompatibility in vitro and no overt acute toxicity in vivo ; repeated immunization induced early cytokine responses and local infiltration without detectable hepatic or renal abnormalities. Collectively, NA@DCM integrates lymph node-targeted delivery, TLR9-associated signaling, and mitochondrial bioenergetic modulation, supporting further preclinical development as a hepatitis B vaccine adjuvant.
abstract_zh: :乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是全球主要的公共卫生问题。尽管乙型肝炎亚基疫苗安全有效,但改进的佐剂可能会进一步增强其免疫原性。我们开发了 NA@DCM,一种铝基复合纳米佐剂,其中包含共价缀合 DSPE-PEG-CpG 1018 (DC) 缀合物的 DSPE-PEG 2000 纳米胶束与纳米铝 (NA) 进行界面组装。我们评估了小鼠模型中引流淋巴结 (dLN) 的生物分布、免疫原性和生物安全性,并通过转录组学、蛋白质印迹和药理学抑制分析检查了 B 细胞激活机制。与游离 CpG 相比,NA@DCM 在 6 小时增强了 dLN 中 CpG 相关的积累,并在 48 小时内具有持续保留和成分共定位。与其单独成分及其物理混合物相比,NA@DCM 增加了抗原特异性 IgG 滴度、IgG2c/IgG1 比率、IFN-γ + /TNF-α + / IL-2 + /IL-4 + CD4 + 和 CD8 + T 细胞以及生发中心反应,并与总 IgG 中的 AS04 样参考制剂相匹配。这些特征与 Th1 偏向性抗体谱一致。从机制上讲,NA@DCM 增强了 Toll 样受体 9 (TLR9​​)–NF-κB 信号传导和线粒体功能,并增加了超氧化物相关荧光、ATP 产生和呼吸链复合物活性。Oligomycin A 对 ATP 合酶的抑制减弱了人 Namalwa 和原代小鼠 B 细胞中的生物能反应和 CD69/CD86 上调,表明线粒体 ATP 合成是 NA@DCM 诱导的 B 细胞激活所必需的。NA@DCM 在体外表现出良好的血液相容性,在体内无明显的急性毒性;重复免疫诱导早期细胞因子反应和局部浸润,但未检测到肝脏或肾脏异常。总的来说,NA@DCM 整合了淋巴结靶向递送、TLR9 相关信号传导和线粒体生物能调节,支持作为乙型肝炎 疫苗 佐剂的进一步临床前开发。

title: Chemiluminescence immunoassay and nucleic acid testing for TTI screening: A narrative review of performance, complementarity, and blood safety
abstract: Introduction: Screening for transfusion-transmitted infections (TTIs) is essential to blood safety. Chemiluminescence immunoassay (ChLIA) enables automated, high-throughput serological screening, whereas nucleic acid testing (NAT) detects viral nucleic acids and reduces the diagnostic window period. This review aimed to evaluate ChLIA for screening hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), and syphilis; compare its performance with NAT for HBV, HCV, and HIV; and examine the implications for transfusion safety.Methods: A directed narrative review was conducted by a single reviewer (A.K.). PubMed was searched on September 7, 2026, using a predefined, reproducible search strategy. Supplementary searches included peer-reviewed journals, reference lists, World Health Organization publications, and official Indonesian regulatory sources. Studies were prioritized according to their relevance to blood donor screening, ChLIA–NAT comparisons, residual transfusion risk, occult HBV infection, and Indonesian regulatory requirements. Uncertain records underwent full-text assessment.Results: The included studies varied in assay characteristics, screening markers, donor populations, and reference standards, precluding meaningful pooling or generalization of diagnostic accuracy estimates. ChLIA and NAT detect distinct biological targets, with their relative contributions to blood safety influenced by pathogen epidemiology, residual risk, regulatory requirements, and healthcare resources. Findings from Shahin et al. and the Indonesian study are presented with their respective denominators and discordant testing patterns to ensure appropriate interpretation.Conclusion: ChLIA demonstrates high diagnostic performance, although accuracy varies across assays and clinical settings. Its complementary use with NAT may enhance transfusion safety when guided by pathogen-specific residual risk, local epidemiology, regulatory requirements, and healthcare capacity. Both approaches should be integrated within comprehensive quality assurance and hemovigilance systems.

title: CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis beyond programmed cell death protein 1 in hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated hepatocellular carcinoma develops in a chronically inflamed, tolerogenic liver microenvironment. In this setting, T-cell dysfunction limits the efficacy of programmed death-1 (PD-1) blockade. Emerging evidence from Liu et al published in the World Journal of Gastrointestinal Oncology suggests that CD161 may represent an additional inhibitory axis within exhausted CD8+ T cells that is not fully captured by the PD-1/ programmed death ligand-1 pathway. In their study, CD161+CD8+ T cells were enriched in tumor tissue, and CD161 expression persisted even as PD-1+ compartments contracted after PD-1 inhibition, suggesting that CD161-mediated restraint may remain active under therapeutic pressure. Mechanistically, sustained engagement of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 interaction may impair T-cell effector function and contribute to adaptive immune resistance in the HBV-infected liver. These findings highlight the importance of protein-level assessment of CD161 and parallel evaluation with PD-1 to accurately characterize immune inhibition. Key knowledge gaps include the cellular source of lectin-like transcript 1 within the tumor microenvironment, the influence of ongoing HBV virological activity on CD161+ T-cell subsets, and the identification of clinically meaningful progression endpoints. In this editorial, we place these findings in mechanistic and translational context, highlighting the potential role of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis as a complementary pathway of immune resistance beyond PD-1 blockade. Collectively, the current evidence supports a cautious, hypothesis-driven translational strategy to evaluate combined modulation of the CD161 and PD-1 axes in carefully selected patients with HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.

title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 相关肝细胞癌中 CD161 凝集素样转录物 1 轴超出程序性细胞死亡蛋白 1
source_body_en: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated hepatocellular carcinoma develops in a chronically inflamed, tolerogenic liver microenvironment. In this setting, T-cell dysfunction limits the efficacy of programmed death-1 (PD-1) blockade. Emerging evidence from Liu et al published in the World Journal of Gastrointestinal Oncology suggests that CD161 may represent an additional inhibitory axis within exhausted CD8+ T cells that is not fully captured by the PD-1/ programmed death ligand-1 pathway. In their study, CD161+CD8+ T cells were enriched in tumor tissue, and CD161 expression persisted even as PD-1+ compartments contracted after PD-1 inhibition, suggesting that CD161-mediated restraint may remain active under therapeutic pressure. Mechanistically, sustained engagement of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 interaction may impair T-cell effector function and contribute to adaptive immune resistance in the HBV-infected liver. These findings highlight the importance of protein-level assessment of CD161 and parallel evaluation with PD-1 to accurately characterize immune inhibition. Key knowledge gaps include the cellular source of lectin-like transcript 1 within the tumor microenvironment, the influence of ongoing HBV virological activity on CD161+ T-cell subsets, and the identification of clinically meaningful progression endpoints. In this editorial, we place these findings in mechanistic and translational context, highlighting the potential role of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis as a complementary pathway of immune resistance beyond PD-1 blockade. Collectively, the current evidence supports a cautious, hypothesis-driven translational strategy to evaluate combined modulation of the CD161 and PD-1 axes in carefully selected patients with HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 相关肝细胞癌在慢性炎症、耐受性肝脏微环境中发生。在这种情况下,T 细胞功能障碍限制了程序性死亡 1 (PD-1) 阻断的功效。Liu 等人发表在《世界胃肠肿瘤学杂志》上的新证据表明,CD161 可能代表耗尽的 CD8+ T 细胞内的另一个抑制轴,该轴未被 PD-1/程序性死亡配体-1 通路完全捕获。在他们的研究中,CD161+CD8+T细胞在肿瘤组织中富集,即使PD-1+区室在PD-1抑制后收缩,CD161表达仍然持续,这表明CD161介导的抑制可能在治疗压力下保持活跃。从机制上讲,CD161-凝集素样转录物 1 相互作用的持续参与可能会损害 T 细胞效应器功能,并有助于 HBV 感染肝脏中的适应性免疫抵抗。这些发现强调了 CD161 蛋白质水平评估和 PD-1 平行评估对于准确表征免疫抑制的重要性。关键知识差距包括肿瘤微环境中凝集素样转录物 1 的细胞来源、持续的 HBV 病毒学活性对 CD161+ T 细胞亚群的影响,以及临床有意义的进展终点的识别。在这篇社论中,我们将这些发现置于机制和转化背景中,强调了 CD161 凝集素样转录物 1 轴作为 PD-1 阻断之外的免疫抵抗的补充途径的潜在作用。总的来说,当前的证据支持谨慎的、假设驱动的转化策略,以评估精心挑选的 HBV 相关肝细胞癌患者中 CD161 和 PD-1 轴的联合调节。

title: PREVALENCE AND EPIDEMIOLOGICAL PROFILE OF HEPATITIS B VIRUS INFECTION IN A POPULATION SAMPLE FROM SOUTHERN ROMANIA: A FOUR-YEAR RETROSPECTIVE ANALYSIS (2021–2024)
abstract: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge. The present retrospective study evaluated the HBsAg seroprevalence in a sample of 5501 patients tested in Alexandria (Teleorman County) between 2021 and 2024 using rapid immunochromatographic methods. The overall seropositivity rate was 4.45 % (245 cases), with a significantly higher prevalence in males compared to females (5.62 % vs. 3.99 %, p = 0.0078; OR = 1.44). The age distribution showed a progressive increase reaching 5.68% in the 50–64 age group, whereas no positive cases were recorded in the under-18 age group, confirming the effectiveness of thenational HBV vaccination program launched in 1995. Temporal dynamics revealed a slight increase in annual prevalence from 3.95 % in 2022 to 5.04 % in 2024, highlighting the necessity of continuing population screening campaigns.
journal: ANNALS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CRAIOVA, Biology, Horticulture, Food products processing technology, Environmental engineering

elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用快速免疫色谱法检测 2021 年至 2024 年间来自亚历山大的 5501 名患者的人群样本中的 HBsAg。

title: Pegylated interferon α-2b add-on to nucleos(t)ide analogues reduces hepatocellular carcinoma and decompensation in advanced fibrotic chronic hepatitis B
abstract: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

analysis_zh.methods: 采用 1:1 倾向评分匹配方法来平衡各组之间的基线特征。在生存分析中,肝细胞癌 (HCC) 和失代偿性肝硬化的结果根据基线临床特征和既定的 HCC 风险评分进行分层。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该分析包括 302 对配对,中位随访时间为 220 周。与 NA 单一疗法相比,联合治疗与发生 HCC(风险比 = 0.22;95% CI:0.11-0.48)和失代偿性肝硬化(风险比 = 0.39;95% CI:0.20-0.77)的风险显着降低相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些益处在经验证的 HCC 预测模型分类为中高风险的患者以及持续生化异常持续 > 12 个月的患者中尤其明显。Peg-IFNα-2b 与 NA 的附加治疗与患有 HBV 相关晚期纤维化或肝硬化的高危患者的 HCC 减少和代偿失调显着相关,支持其在该人群中的使用。

title: Comparative Biomarker Profiles Across Stages of Chronic Hepatitis B
abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB), liver cirrhosis (LC), and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) are progressive stages of HBV infection that represent a global health concern. In many regions, advanced diagnostic tools are not readily available; therefore, accessible, cost-effective assays are needed to differentiate these disease stages. This study compared inflammatory, biochemical, and virological biomarker profiles, encompassing the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), platelet count, aspartate transaminase (AST), alanine transaminase (ALT), AST-to-platelet ratio index (APRI), fibrosis-4 score (FIB-4), and HBV DNA levels, across HBV-related liver disease stages. A retrospective cross-sectional study enrolled 213 patients with chronic HBV infection, categorized as CHB (n=166), LC (n=27), and HCC (n=20) at The General Hospital of West Nusa Tenggara Province between January 2022 and December 2023. The Kruskal-Wallis and post hoc tests were used for the analysis. The NLR was significantly higher in the HCC group compared to both the CHB (p=0.0001) and LC (p<0.01) groups. Platelet count revealed a progressive decline from CHB to LC (p<0.0001) but exhibited a subsequent increase from LC to HCC (p<0.0001), with no significant difference observed between the CHB and HCC groups. Aspartate transaminase (AST) levels increased significantly across all disease stages, whereas ALT levels showed no significant variation. Both APRI and FIB-4 scores were significantly higher in the LC and HCC groups compared to the CHB group (p<0.0001), but did not differ between LC and HCC. HBV DNA levels were elevated in HCC but failed to reach statistical significance. Consequently, these accessible biomarkers could play an important role in monitoring and staging HBV-induced liver disease in settings lacking advanced diagnostic facilities.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to compare inflammatory, biochemical, and virological biomarker profiles across stages of HBV infection, including chronic hepatitis B (CHB), liver cirrhosis (LC), and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Conducted at The General Hospital of West Nusa Tenggara Province between January 2022 and December 2023, the retrospective cross-sectional study enrolled 213 patients. The Kruskal-Wallis and post hoc tests were used to analyze the data. The NLR was significantly higher in the HCC group compared to CHB and LC, while platelet count showed a decline from CHB to LC and an increase from LC to HCC. AST levels increased across all stages, but ALT levels remained stable. APRI and FIB-4 scores were significantly higher in LC and HCC compared to CHB. These findings suggest that certain biomarkers may be useful in differentiating disease stages, particularly in resource-limited settings. The study's limitations include its retrospective design and potential for selection bias, but the evidence is strong due to the statistical significance of the results and the use of well-established biomarkers.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB)、肝硬化 (LC) 和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 是 HBV 感染的进展阶段,代表着全球健康问题。本研究旨在比较这些阶段的生物标志物概况,以确定可用于疾病分期且具有成本效益的标志物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性横断面研究招募了 2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间在西努沙登加拉省总医院入组的 213 名慢性 HBV 感染患者,分为 CHB (n=166)、LC (n=27) 和 HCC (n=20)。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用 Kruskal-Wallis 和事后检验进行分析。它比较了炎症、生化和病毒学生物标志物,包括中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比率 (NLR)、血小板计数、天冬氨酸转氨酶 (AST)、丙氨酸转氨酶 (ALT)、AST 与血小板比率指数 (APRI)、纤维化 4 评分 (FIB-4) 和 HBV DNA 水平。
elements_zh.main_results: 与 CHB (p=0.0001) 和 LC (p<0.01) 组相比,HCC 组的 NLR 显着较高。血小板计数显示从 CHB 到 LC 逐渐下降 (p<0.0001),但随后从 LC 到 HCC 逐渐增加 (p<0.0001),在 CHB 和 HCC 组之间没有观察到显着差异。AST 水平在所有疾病阶段均显着增加,而 ALT 水平没有显着变化。与 CHB 组相比,LC 和 HCC 组的 APRI 和 FIB-4 评分均显着较高 (p<0.0001),但 LC 和 HCC 之间没有差异。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,某些生物标志物,例如 NLR 和 APRI,可能有助于区分疾病阶段,特别是在资源有限、无法获得先进诊断工具的环境中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以为开发可利用的生物标志物提供信息,用于在诊断资源有限的地区监测和分期乙型肝炎引起的肝病。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的选择偏倚而受到限制。然而,鉴于结果的统计显着性和成熟生物标志物的使用,证据是强有力的。

title: Interferon therapy reduces incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with high risk of hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma
abstract: BACKGROUND The proportion of patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is as high as 85.69% among HCC patients in China. Current anti-HBV drugs include nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) and interferon (IFN). AIM To compare the impact of NAs and IFN therapy on the occurrence of HCC in patients at high risk of HBV-related HCC. METHODS We enrolled 368 patients with high risk of HBV-related HCC, and 120 received subcutaneous injections of IFN, with or without NAs, constituting the IFN group. The remaining 248 patients were assigned to the NAs group, and received treatment with NAs alone. RESULTS For patients with a high risk of HBV-related HCC, after a 5-year treatment period, HCC incidence in the IFN group was 2.54%, while the NAs group showed a significantly higher incidence of 25.74% (P CONCLUSION IFN-based therapy, compared with NAs, significantly reduced the risk of HCC in patients with high risk of HBV-related HCC.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the high incidence of HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in China and evaluate the impact of interferon (IFN) therapy versus nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) on HCC occurrence in high-risk patients.

analysis.methods: Patients were enrolled and followed for a 5-year treatment period. HCC incidence was monitored and compared between the IFN group and the NAs group using statistical analysis to determine significance.
analysis.main_results: After 5 years of treatment, the HCC incidence in the IFN group was 2.54%, while the NAs group had a significantly higher incidence of 25.74% (P < 0.001).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence that IFN-based therapy significantly reduces HCC risk compared to NAs alone in high-risk HBV patients, highlighting a novel therapeutic approach.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results suggest that IFN-based therapy could be a more effective option for reducing HCC incidence in patients at high risk of HBV-related HCC, potentially informing treatment guidelines and public health strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential for confounding factors, but the evidence is strong due to the clear comparison between IFN and NAs groups and the statistically significant results.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of interferon (IFN) therapy versus nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence in patients at high risk of HBV-related HCC. The research aimed to address the high prevalence of HBV-related HCC in China and evaluate therapeutic efficacy. A retrospective cohort study enrolled 368 patients, with 120 receiving IFN therapy and 248 receiving NA therapy alone. After 5 years, HCC incidence was 2.54% in the IFN group and 25.74% in the NAs group (P < 0.001). The authors concluded that IFN-based therapy significantly reduces HCC risk compared to NAs alone, offering a novel therapeutic approach. These findings may inform treatment guidelines for high-risk HBV patients. The study's retrospective design introduces potential limitations, but the results are robust due to the clear comparison and statistical significance.

title: Prevalence of hepatitis B and hepatitis C in the general population of Pakistan: a systematic review and meta-analysis of serological and active infection, 2010–2025
abstract: This systematic review and meta-analysis will estimate the pooled prevalence of hepatitis B (HBsAg) and hepatitis C (anti-HCV and HCV RNA) in the general population of Pakistan from 2010 to 2025. HBsAg, anti-HCV and HCV RNA will be pooled separately. The review will examine how prevalence varies by province, time period (2010-2015, 2016-2020, 2021-2025), sex, age group, urban/rural setting, and diagnostic method. Only general-population studies will be included. Blood donors, haemodialysis, thalassaemia, pregnant-women-only, prisoner, injecting drug use and liver-disease-selected samples will be excluded. Databases: PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, Web of Science, PakMediNet and Google Scholar. Two independent reviewers will screen, extract data and assess quality using the JBI Checklist for Prevalence Studies. Analysis will use a random-effects model in R. Reporting will follow PRISMA 2020.

title: Seroprotection Status Against Hepatitis B among Children on Bawean Island, Indonesia
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major global public health concern, particularly in developing regions. Vaccination significantly reduces infection rates, but seroprotection may decline over time, necessitating periodic evaluation. This study evaluated the seroprotection rates against hepatitis B and the prevalence of HBV infection among children on Bawean Island, Indonesia. A cross-sectional study was conducted involving 90 children aged 3-15 years from various villages on Bawean Island. Blood samples were collected to determine hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs) levels using an Electrochemiluminescence Immunoassay (ECLIA). Seroprotection was defined as anti-HBs titers ≥10 mIU/mL. Statistical analyses were performed using SPSS Version 25, utilizing the chi-square test for categorical variables and the Spearman correlation test for continuous data. None of the subjects were reactive for HBsAg (0%). The overall anti-HBs seroprotection rate among the children was 67.8 %. There was a significant difference between seroprotection status and age (p<0.001). However, no significant difference was found between seroprotection status and sex (p=0.259) or basic immunization history (p=0.627). A significant negative correlation was found between age and Anti-HBs titers (r=-0.404, p<0.001). This study demonstrates the presence of seroprotection among children on Bawean Island. The significant age-dependent decline in anti-HBs titers highlights the potential need for a booster vaccination strategy in this remote island population to ensure long-term immunity.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed the seroprotection rates against hepatitis B and the prevalence of HBV infection among 90 children on Bawean Island, Indonesia. It found that 67.8% of the children had anti-HBs titers ≥10 mIU/mL, indicating seroprotection. The study highlights the potential need for booster vaccination strategies in this remote population to maintain long-term immunity. The findings are based on a cross-sectional design and statistical analyses using SPSS Version 25, which provides moderate evidence for the observed trends.

title_zh: 印度尼西亚巴威安岛儿童乙型肝炎血清保护状况
source_body_en: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major global public health concern, particularly in developing regions. Vaccination significantly reduces infection rates, but seroprotection may decline over time, necessitating periodic evaluation. This study evaluated the seroprotection rates against hepatitis B and the prevalence of HBV infection among children on Bawean Island, Indonesia. A cross-sectional study was conducted involving 90 children aged 3-15 years from various villages on Bawean Island. Blood samples were collected to determine hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs) levels using an Electrochemiluminescence Immunoassay (ECLIA). Seroprotection was defined as anti-HBs titers ≥10 mIU/mL. Statistical analyses were performed using SPSS Version 25, utilizing the chi-square test for categorical variables and the Spearman correlation test for continuous data. None of the subjects were reactive for HBsAg (0%). The overall anti-HBs seroprotection rate among the children was 67.8 %. There was a significant difference between seroprotection status and age (p<0.001). However, no significant difference was found between seroprotection status and sex (p=0.259) or basic immunization history (p=0.627). A significant negative correlation was found between age and Anti-HBs titers (r=-0.404, p<0.001). This study demonstrates the presence of seroprotection among children on Bawean Island. The significant age-dependent decline in anti-HBs titers highlights the potential need for a booster vaccination strategy in this remote island population to ensure long-term immunity.

title: Clonorchis sinensis co-infection potentiates polymorphonuclear-myeloid-derived suppressor cells expansion and metabolic reprogramming in chronic hepatitis B patients
abstract: BACKGROUND Clonorchis sinensis (C. sinensis ) co-infection is known to accelerate disease progression and induce immune tolerance in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV), particularly in regions where both infections are endemic. Metabolic reprogramming has emerged as a key driver of immunosuppression. These metabolic shifts are often orchestrated by myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs), which expand during chronic infections to promote immune tolerance. sinensis co-infection reprograms metabolism to favor MDSC-linked suppression and how this process relates to normal liver enzyme levels remains unclear. AIM To investigate whether C. sinensis co-infection induces MDSC- linked metabolic reprogramming in patients with HBV and normal liver enzyme levels. METHODS In this cross-sectional study, a total of 117 participants were enrolled and assigned to four groups: Healthy controls (n = 30), C. sinensis mono-infected participants (n = 29), HBV mono-infected participants (n = 28), and co-infected participants (n = 30). Serum cytokine profiles were measured using chemiluminescence immunoassay, amino acid metabolites using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and MDSC subsets using flow cytometry. Spearman correlation and mediation analyses were performed to explore the relationships among inflammation, metabolism, and immunity. RESULTS HBV mono-infected and co-infected patients showed no statistically significant differences in liver enzyme and HBV DNA levels. However, compared with the HBV mono-infected group, the co-infected group had higher levels of the inflammatory cytokine: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), accompanied by markedly lower interferon-γ (IFN-γ) levels. Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨华支睾吸虫合并感染是否会在肝酶水平正常的 HBV 患者中诱导 MDSC 相关的代谢重编程。背景强调,已知中华支原体合并感染会加速乙型肝炎患者的疾病进展并诱导免疫耐受,特别是在流行地区。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究纳入了 117 名参与者,分为四组:健康对照(n = 30)、中华支原体单一感染参与者(n = 29)、HBV 单一感染参与者(n = 28)和混合感染参与者(n = 30)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用化学发光免疫测定法测量血清细胞因子谱,使用液相色谱-串联质谱法测量氨基酸代谢物,并使用流式细胞术测量MDSC子集。流式细胞术检测显示,多形核MDSC(PMN-MDSC)在共感染组中表现出最大的扩增,并且其比例与IL-6和TNF-α水平密切相关。
elements_zh.main_results: HBV单一感染和合并感染患者的肝酶和HBV DNA水平无统计学差异。然而,共同感染组的炎症细胞因子:白细胞介素-6 (IL-6) 和肿瘤坏死因子-α (TNF-α) 水平较高,同时干扰素-γ (IFN-γ) 水平明显较低。中介分析表明,PMN-MDSC 约占 IL-6 对 IFN-γ 抑制总效应的 45%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,中华线虫合并感染与通过 IL-6/TNF-α 连接的 PMN-MDSC 扩增和鸟氨酸与精氨酸比率升高而产生的免疫抑制有关,导致尽管肝酶水平正常,但 IFN-γ 的产生受到抑制。这一发现强调了共感染可能调节 HBV 患者 免疫应答 的新机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于了解合并感染 HBV 患者的免疫调节,并可能指导未来基于免疫的治疗和针对合并感染情况的 监测 策略的研究。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是横断面的,限制了其建立因果关系的能力。证据基于相关性和中介分析,可能无法完全捕捉感染与 免疫应答 之间复杂的相互作用。信心是中等的。

Serum cytokine profiles were measured using chemiluminescence immunoassay, amino acid metabolites using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and MDSC subsets using flow cytometry. Spearman correlation and mediation analyses were performed to explore the relationships among inflammation, metabolism, and immunity. RESULTS HBV mono-infected and co-infected patients showed no statistically significant differences in liver enzyme and HBV DNA levels. However, compared with the HBV mono-infected group, the co-infected group had higher levels of the inflammatory cytokine: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), accompanied by markedly lower interferon-γ (IFN-γ) levels. Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.
abstract_zh: 背景已知华支睾吸虫(C. sinensis)合并感染会加速乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)患者的疾病进展并诱导免疫耐受,特别是在两种感染流行的地区。代谢重编程已成为免疫抑制的关键驱动因素。这些代谢变化通常是由骨髓源性抑制细胞(MDSC)精心策划的,这些细胞在慢性感染期间会扩张以促进免疫耐受。中华丝虫合并感染会重新编程代谢以有利于 MDSC 相关的抑制,而这一过程与正常肝酶水平的关系仍不清楚。目的 探讨中华支原体合并感染是否会诱导肝酶水平正常的 HBV 患者发生 MDSC 相关的代谢重编程。方法 在这项横断面研究中,总共招募了 117 名参与者,并分为四组:健康对照(n = 30)、单一感染中华支原体的参与者(n = 29)、单一感染 HBV 的参与者(n = 28)和混合感染的参与者(n = 30)。使用化学发光免疫测定法测量血清细胞因子谱,使用液相色谱-串联质谱法测量氨基酸代谢物,并使用流式细胞术测量MDSC子集。进行 Spearman 相关性和中介分析来探讨炎症、代谢和免疫之间的关系。结果 HBV单一感染和合并感染患者的肝酶和HBV DNA水平无统计学差异。然而,与HBV单一感染组相比,合并感染组的炎症细胞因子白细胞介素6(IL-6)和肿瘤坏死因子-α(TNF-α)水平较高,同时干扰素-γ(IFN-γ)水平明显较低。流式细胞术检测显示,多形核MDSC(PMN-MDSC)在共感染组中表现出最大的扩增,并且其比例与IL-6和TNF-α水平密切相关。在代谢方面,共同感染组的鸟氨酸与精氨酸的比率显着较高。中介分析表明,PMN-MDSC 约占 IL-6 对 IFN-γ 抑制总效应的 45%。中华线虫合并感染通过 IL-6/TNF-α 连接的 PMN-MDSC 扩增和鸟氨酸与精氨酸比率升高与免疫抑制相关,导致尽管肝酶水平正常,但 IFN-γ 的产生受到抑制。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,中华线虫合并感染与通过 IL-6/TNF-α 连接的 PMN-MDSC 扩增和鸟氨酸与精氨酸比率升高而产生的免疫抑制有关,导致尽管肝酶水平正常,但 IFN-γ 的产生受到抑制。这一发现强调了共感染可能调节 HBV 患者 免疫应答 的新机制。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于了解合并感染 HBV 患者的免疫调节,并可能指导未来基于免疫的治疗和针对合并感染情况的 监测 策略的研究。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是横断面的,限制了其建立因果关系的能力。证据基于相关性和中介分析,可能无法完全捕捉感染与 免疫应答 之间复杂的相互作用。信心是中等的。

title: Chaos control and bifurcations of a discrete Hepatitis B virus model
abstract: In this paper, we examine the local dynamics, bifurcation sets, basic reproduction number (BRN), chaos, convergence rate and bifurcation analysis at equilibrium states of a four-dimensional discrete HBV model. More specifically, we first give the mathematical formulation of a four-dimensional discrete HBV model, and then local behavior is explored by the linear stability theory. Moreover, at equilibrium states, we have identified the bifurcation sets, and then we have studied the bifurcations at equilibrium states of the discrete HBV model by the bifurcation theory. We have studied chaos and convergence rate for the understudied HBV model. Finally, our theoretical outcomes are confirmed numerically.

title_zh: 离散 乙型肝炎病毒 模型的混沌控制和分岔
source_body_en: In this paper, we examine the local dynamics, bifurcation sets, basic reproduction number (BRN), chaos, convergence rate and bifurcation analysis at equilibrium states of a four-dimensional discrete HBV model. More specifically, we first give the mathematical formulation of a four-dimensional discrete HBV model, and then local behavior is explored by the linear stability theory. Moreover, at equilibrium states, we have identified the bifurcation sets, and then we have studied the bifurcations at equilibrium states of the discrete HBV model by the bifurcation theory. We have studied chaos and convergence rate for the understudied HBV model. Finally, our theoretical outcomes are confirmed numerically.

title: Gambaran Hasil Pemeriksaan Blood Borne Virus (HIV, HBV, HCV) dan Profil Leukosit pada Pasien Gagal Ginjal yang Menjalani Hemodialisis
abstract: Salah satu masalah kesehatan yang masih terus meningkat prevalensinya di seluruh dunia adalah penyakit ginjal kronis (PGK). Pasien PGK yang menjalani hemodialisis memiliki risiko terpapar Blood Borne Virus (BBV) karena adanya prosedur yang melibatkan paparan darah secara berulang. Selain itu, kondisi uremia pada PGK dapat berkaitan dengan proses inflamasi kronis yang tercermin melalui perubahan profil leukosit. Studi ini berguna untuk mengkarakterisasi profil leukosit dan hasil tes BBV pada pasien PGK yang menjalani hemodialisis di Rumah Sakit PKU Muhammadiyah di Yogyakarta. Sesuai dengan data dari tahun 2025 rekam medis, studi ini mengenakan metode deskriptif dengan pendekatan retrospektif. Sampel penelitian terdiri atas 33 pasien yang diperoleh melalui teknik purposive sampling. Pemeriksaan BBV mencakup HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus), HBV (Hepatitis B Virus), dan HCV (Hepatitis C Virus) menggunakan rapid test, sementara pemeriksaan profil leukosit dilakukan dengan hematology analyzer 5-diff. Analisis data dilakukan secara deskriptif. Sebagian besar responden berjenis kelamin laki-laki (54,5%) dan berada pada kelompok usia 18–59 tahun (63,6%). Hasil pemeriksaan menunjukkan seluruh responden nonreaktif terhadap HIV dan negatif HBV, sedangkan HCV positif ditemukan pada 2 responden (6,1%). Rerata jumlah leukosit mencapai 10,13 × 103/μL, dengan rerata neutrofil 75,97% dan limfosit 14,73%. Berdasarkan hasil tersebut, HCV masih ditemukan pada sebagian kecil pasien hemodialisis, sementara HIV dan HBV tidak ditemukan. Profil leukosit memperlihatkan kecenderungan peningkatan neutrofil disertai penurunan limfosit yang dapat menggambarkan adanya respons inflamasi pada pasien PGK yang menjalani hemodialisis.

title: Hepatitis B Reactivation and Infection in People with HIV on Tenofovir-Sparing Antiretroviral Therapy
abstract: As more people with HIV (PWH) transition to tenofovir (TXF)-sparing antiretroviral therapy (ART), the risk of hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation (HBVr) and new infection (HBVi) is a concern. We conducted a retrospective study of 5,776 PWH in the Centers for AIDS Research Network of Integrated Clinical Systems cohort without active HBV infection with ≥1 TXF-sparing ART regimen prescribed after 5/1/2014 and examined episodes of HBVi/r defined as new HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) positivity or HBV viremia. We calculated rate of HBVi/r over total time on TXF-sparing ART per 10,000 person-years. We identified 17 cases of HBVi/r over a median 5.3 years of follow up. The rate of HBVi was 3.9 per 10,000 person-years, and rate of HBVr was 6.0 per 10,000 person-years, with possible higher risk for those who were HBV surface antibody (HBsAb) negative at cohort entry and among those not on ART with no anti-HBV activity. Liver injury, defined as alanine aminotransferase lab value ≥ 100 U/L, occurred within 3 months in only one HBVi case. HBVi/r on TXF-sparing ART was rare in this U.S. HBVi/r occurred in some with prior HBsAb positivity, but significant hepatic flares were not observed. When starting TXF-sparing ART, providers should check complete HBV serologies, offer initial or additional vaccination as needed, and monitor for potential HBVi/r.

title: Characteristics of needlestick injuries and post-exposure practices among healthcare workers in private hospitals in Alexandria, Egypt
abstract: Abstract Needlestick injuries (NSIs) are a major occupational hazard among healthcare workers (HCWs), with potential exposure to blood-borne pathogens and associated health consequences. A retrospective record-based study was conducted using 318 records of HCWs who experienced NSIs during 2023–2024 in four private hospitals in Alexandria, Egypt, all with standardized NSI reporting systems. Data included demographic and occupational characteristics, injury circumstances, safety practices, hepatitis B vaccination status, infection prevention and control (IPC) training, and post-exposure management. Most NSIs occurred among female HCWs (61.6%), and nurses represented the largest affected occupational group (63.5%). Syringes were involved in 65.1% of NSIs, while sudden patient movement was the most frequently reported contributing factor (26.1%). Among records with documented IPC training status, 79.8% indicated no prior training, while training status was missing in 36.2% of records. Overall, 16.0% of HCWs were documented as unvaccinated against hepatitis B. Post-exposure actions were not documented in 30.8% of records, and only 29.6% of HCWs underwent documented post-exposure testing for hepatitis C virus, hepatitis B, and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). These findings highlight gaps in IPC training, hepatitis B vaccination, and post-exposure management and underscore the need for standardized reporting, timely post-exposure care, and improved occupational safety practices.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 针刺伤 (NSI) 对医护人员 (HCW) 构成严重的职业危害,可能会接触血源性病原体并造成相关的健康后果。本研究旨在描述埃及亚历山大私立医院的 NSI 和暴露后做法。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用 2023 年至 2024 年期间在埃及亚历山大的四家私立医院经历过 NSI 的 318 名医护人员的记录进行了一项基于记录的回顾性研究,所有医院均采用标准化的 NSI 报告系统。数据包括人口和职业特征、受伤情况、安全实践、乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 状态、感染预防和控制 (IPC) 培训以及暴露后管理。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究利用现有记录收集 NSI 数据,包括人口和职业特征、受伤情况、安全实践、乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 状态、IPC 培训和暴露后管理。所提供的证据中没有详细说明具体的实验室或统计程序。
elements_zh.main_results: 大多数 NSI 发生在女性医护人员 (61.6%) 中,护士是受影响最大的职业群体 (63.5%)。65.1% 的 NSI 涉及注射器,而患者突然移动是最常报告的促成因素 (26.1%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调需要改进职业安全实践,并强调对暴露于 乙型肝炎病毒 的医护人员进行标准化报告和及时暴露后护理的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为制定有针对性的干预措施提供了依据,以改善埃及亚历山大私立医院医护人员的 乙型肝炎病毒 预防和暴露后管理实践。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于回顾性记录,这可能会引入偏差并限制报告实践的准确性。由于依赖现有数据且缺乏详细的统计分析,证据强度中等。

title: Thymoma-Associated Pancytopenia Resolving After Thymectomy: A Case Report and Literature Review
abstract: Thymoma is frequently associated with paraneoplastic syndromes, of which myasthenia gravis is the best known.Hematologic manifestations such as pancytopenia are rare, and published cases suggest that surgery alone is often insufficient, with immunosuppressive therapy frequently required.We report the case of a 28-year-old woman, deaf-mute since birth, who presented with chronic abdominal pain of 10 months' duration.Investigations showed pancytopenia (normochromic normocytic nonregenerative anemia, neutropenia, and thrombocytopenia) and homogeneous hepatosplenomegaly.The blood smear showed rouleaux formation of the red blood cells and a few activated lymphocytes.The bone marrow aspirate showed a reactive marrow, and the bone marrow biopsy was normal.Serologies for parvovirus B19, hepatitis C virus (HCV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), and HIV were negative.Liver, renal, and hemostasis tests were normal, and the immunologic workup was negative.Plasma protein electrophoresis showed polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia.The absence of an identified hematologic, infectious, or autoimmune cause led to further imaging.Thoraco-abdomino-pelvic CT revealed a 32 × 27 mm anterior mediastinal mass.Right video-assisted thoracoscopic thymectomy was performed.Histology showed a wellencapsulated type B2 thymoma, Masaoka-Koga stage I.After thymectomy alone, with no immunosuppressive treatment, the cytopenias regressed, the hepatomegaly disappeared, and the splenomegaly decreased.This case suggests that, in a small, encapsulated thymoma with a non-aplastic marrow, upfront thymectomy with close hematologic monitoring may be a reasonable first step, with immunosuppressive therapy kept for patients whose blood counts do not recover after surgery.

title: Therapeutic and Prophylactic Agents for Viral Diseases: Current Status, Challenges, and Future Prospects.
abstract: Viral diseases remain a major global health challenge despite substantial advances in vaccination, antiviral therapeutics, and public-health interventions. However, current antiviral strategies are still constrained by important gaps, including rapid viral evolution, limited broad-spectrum efficacy, immune escape, antiviral resistance, incomplete durability of protection, and inequitable global access to prevention and treatment. This review provides a comprehensive and integrated overview of contemporary antiviral prevention and therapeutic strategies, spanning vaccines, monoclonal antibodies, direct-acting antivirals, host-targeted therapies, immunomodulators, RNA-based therapeutics, gene-editing technologies, and cellular immunotherapies. We discuss the mechanistic foundations, clinical applications, pharmacologic considerations, and translational challenges associated with each modality across major human viral pathogens, including HIV, HBV, HCV, influenza, SARS-CoV-2, RSV, Ebola virus, arboviruses, and herpesviruses. Particular emphasis is placed on emerging innovations such as long-acting prophylaxis, Fc-engineered monoclonal antibodies, nanoparticle and mucosal vaccine platforms, CRISPR-based antiviral systems, and broadly protective host-directed approaches designed to overcome resistance and enhance pandemic preparedness. In addition, we highlight the growing importance of real-time genomic surveillance and equitable global deployment strategies in shaping future antiviral responses, collectively underscoring that the next generation of antiviral medicine will depend on the convergence of universal immunization strategies, durable therapeutics, precision immune modulation, and rapidly deployable platform technologies capable of addressing both endemic and emerging viral threats.

This review provides a comprehensive and integrated overview of contemporary antiviral prevention and therapeutic strategies, spanning vaccines, monoclonal antibodies, direct-acting antivirals, host-targeted therapies, immunomodulators, RNA-based therapeutics, gene-editing technologies, and cellular immunotherapies. We discuss the mechanistic foundations, clinical applications, pharmacologic considerations, and translational challenges associated with each modality across major human viral pathogens, including HIV, HBV, HCV, influenza, SARS-CoV-2, RSV, Ebola virus, arboviruses, and herpesviruses. Particular emphasis is placed on emerging innovations such as long-acting prophylaxis, Fc-engineered monoclonal antibodies, nanoparticle and mucosal vaccine platforms, CRISPR-based antiviral systems, and broadly protective host-directed approaches designed to overcome resistance and enhance pandemic preparedness. In addition, we highlight the growing importance of real-time genomic surveillance and equitable global deployment strategies in shaping future antiviral responses, collectively underscoring that the next generation of antiviral medicine will depend on the convergence of universal immunization strategies, durable therapeutics, precision immune modulation, and rapidly deployable platform technologies capable of addressing both endemic and emerging viral threats.
